title: Taxi-dance halls: hostesses, tickets and patrons
summary: Howard describes how dance-hall girls were paid by ticket split, that the halls were all white, who the patrons were, and the slow numbers.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Over at the dance hall? Yeah, like the Vito. Well they have maybe about 25 or so like that. And they got, I think they, I'm quite sure they got half of the ticket. See, the guys come up to the ticket box and they buy it and they think you gotta give it to the girl. Yeah, every dance. Every dance, yeah. Well that's the way that would do it. And then they'd check in when it's time for them to get off, you know. And then they split it down. That's through Heffers Day.
Those were all, both of those places and the other one on Carondale after all for whites.

Oh yeah, all white. Did they ever have any colored zip in the dance? No, no. They tried it one time upon Ramport and Julia. Didn't go. Didn't go, no. They got him ten cents to dance. He'd never make it. No, they did try it one time. I don't think that, I don't think that, I don't think it lasted over a week. It wouldn't pay. No, they didn't go after that.
Anything else about it? Anything else that happened at those dance halls as much as you can think of?
Well, a lot of times they had like anything else. They had some fights sometimes, you know what I mean? They had a ball like that sometimes. And other than that, everything was alright.
Did they last pretty long in the same management? Did they go broke right off in there? How long did you play the music?
Well, no. Everyone that I know of that worked for, they still stayed in business.
They stayed in long time. They must have made a lot of money. Who patronized? Mostly the sailors and seamen off of the boats? Or who would go?

Well, you know, we could tell who they was. Sometimes you know who they was or you know who they was in there. Well, they had a lot of people, or regular citizens. American would come down and they'd get with them. Well, you know what I mean? You know how that goes. You see?
I just wondered because mostly if they were out of town people and fellows that didn't know where to pick up a girl or how it would be.

Well, if they had a lot of things like that too. A lot of sailors and so forth would come in. Different things. But you'd see a regular civilian would be in there. You see? A lot of people they play the slow ones. They play the slow ones. They come up and say, yeah, so you're playing the slow ones. You know what I mean? Yeah. Well, they drop something on you. Make more than five minutes. Yeah.
